propositions: When a plan's affected-file or call-site inventory was enumerated by hand or is demonstrably incomplete rather than derived from the symbol graph, a plan-review finding should be emitted to coach re-derivation with Serena's find_referencing_symbols tool plus string-literal sweep.

Code-review moves are already overlay-driven via load_move_registry reading .rebar/code_review_moves.json; project.* criterion ids cannot be routed through code-review because they fall outside the closed applies_when vocabulary, making such moves dead on arrival.
The criterion must route to plan_review only, where project criterion ids are supported in the triggers union, following the existing project.portability pattern.

The criterion shall have default_posture advisory with no inert blocking_enabled key (code-review-only convention), and moves shall apply when the criterion fires alongside blocking built-ins G1G2, G6, or E4.

Detection of incomplete inventory is largely redundant with shipped built-ins G1G2/G6/E4; the distinctive method coaching (find_referencing_symbols plus string grep) reaches agents through LLM selection, not configuration, and cannot be guaranteed to appear in any single run.
